support.support_for_the_drumfillgenerato: Support for the DrumFillGenerator iOS app — contact, troubleshooting for MIDI tracking and audio, subscription help, and privacy requests.
support.app_version_1_1_build: App version 1.1 (build 9) · iPhone and iPad · iOS 26.5 or later
support.something_not_working_a_question: Something not working, a question about your subscription, or a request about your data? Write to us directly — a real person reads every message.
support.email_is_the_fastest_route: Email is the fastest route. We aim to reply within 2–3 business days.
support.address_ukraine_zhitomir_state_z: Address: Ukraine, Zhitomir state, Zhitomir city, Korolenka street 10, app 9
support.to_get_a_useful_answer: To get a useful answer on the first reply, please include:
support.your_device_model_and_ios: Your device model and iOS version (Settings → General → About).
support.the_app_version_shown_at: The app version shown at the bottom of the in-app Settings screen.
support.what_you_did_what_you: What you did, what you expected, and what happened instead — a screen recording is ideal for audio or timing issues.
support.for_rhythmic_tracking_issues_the: For rhythmic tracking issues: the make and model of your MIDI drum kit and the cable/adapter you are using.
support.drumfillgenerator_opens_straight: DrumFillGenerator opens straight into the Practice tab — no account, no sign-up, no onboarding to sit through.
support.set_your_grid_choose_a: Set your grid. Choose a time signature (4/4 or 3/4), one or more subdivisions (quarter, 8th, 16th, triplet), the bar count, and which of the six drum voices may appear.
support.press_generate_the_app_either: Press Generate. The app either loads a hand-transcribed fill from the 200-fill curated bank or builds a fresh one with the linear generator, depending on your constraints.
support.practice_it_play_loop_adjust: Practice it. Play, loop, adjust the tempo, switch the metronome on, tap any step on the grid to cue there, or drag to scrub.
support.save_it_tap_the_star: Save it. Tap the star to keep a fill in the Favorites tab, where you can rename or delete it later.
support.rhythmic_tracking_says_no_midi: Rhythmic tracking says "No MIDI device detected"
support.rhythmic_tracking_listens_over_c: Rhythmic tracking listens over CoreMIDI, so it needs a physical electronic drum kit or MIDI pad connected to your device. There is no way to enable it without hardware.
support.connect_the_kit_to_your: Connect the kit to your iPhone or iPad over USB-C (or via a Lightning-to-USB camera adapter on older hardware). A charging-only cable will not carry MIDI data — use a data cable.
support.power_the_kit_on_before: Power the kit on before you enable tracking, and check that its USB/MIDI output is enabled in the module's own settings.
support.once_connected_the_tracking_pane: Once connected, the tracking panel shows a connected indicator and the incoming note and velocity. If a "Waiting for MIDI Input" message appears, it dismisses itself on your first hit.
support.if_the_kit_is_unplugged: If the kit is unplugged mid-session, the app stops tracking and playback on purpose and tells you why.
support.the_practice_pad_microphone_inpu: The Practice Pad (microphone) input source is marked SOON and is not selectable in this version.
support.tracking_is_greyed_out_or: Tracking is greyed out or won't start on my fill
support.rhythmic_tracking_currently_supp: Rhythmic tracking currently supports single-bar patterns only. If your fill is 2, 3, or 4 bars long, set the bar count back to 1 and tracking becomes available again. Multi-bar tracking is planned but not in this release.
support.my_hits_are_all_scored: My hits are all scored as misses
support.hits_are_scored_against_the: Hits are scored against the mathematical grid of the pattern in a tight window — roughly ±25 ms counts as on-time, up to ±80 ms registers as early or late, and anything wider is a miss.
support.turn_the_metronome_on_so: Turn the metronome on so you have a reference to lock to.
support.drop_the_tempo_accuracy_at: Drop the tempo. Accuracy at a slow tempo transfers upward; the reverse rarely works.
support.check_that_your_kit_sends: Check that your kit sends a Note On for the pads you are hitting, and that pad sensitivity or threshold on the module is not swallowing soft strokes.
support.scoring_intentionally_ignores_th: Scoring intentionally ignores the Playback Feel humanization offsets, so a "loose" playback setting never shifts the target — the grid stays the reference.
support.there_s_no_sound_or: There's no sound, or the sound cuts out
support.check_the_physical_silent_ring: Check the physical Silent/Ring switch and the volume level, and make sure no other app has grabbed audio output.
support.if_you_are_on_bluetooth: If you are on Bluetooth headphones, expect added latency that is outside the app's control — use wired headphones or the device speaker when practising timing.
support.individual_voices_have_their_own: Individual voices have their own gain sliders in Settings. If one drum is inaudible, check that it is not muted or turned down there, and that it is still included in the generation pool.
support.if_audio_stops_when_you: If audio stops when you leave the app, enable Lock Screen Audio in Settings to keep playback running in the background.
support.if_audio_ever_fails_to: If audio ever fails to start, force-quit the app and reopen it — the audio session is rebuilt on launch.
support.notation_view_multi_bar_fills: Notation view, multi-bar fills, or the prefill groove are locked
support.those_three_are_the_premium: Those three are the premium features. Everything else — all 200 curated fills, the generator, the grid view, all six drum voices, both time signatures, every subdivision, the metronome, favorites, and rhythmic tracking — is free and unlimited.
support.tapping_a_locked_control_opens: Tapping a locked control opens the subscription screen. If the screen reports that premium is unavailable, check your internet connection and try again; the subscription catalog is fetched at that moment.
support.i_paid_but_the_app: I paid but the app still shows the free tier
support.open_settings_restore_purchases_: Open Settings → Restore Purchases in the app. Make sure you are signed in with the same Apple ID that made the purchase.
support.confirm_the_subscription_is_acti: Confirm the subscription is active in iOS Settings → your name → Subscriptions.
support.purchases_are_tied_to_an: Purchases are tied to an anonymous device identifier, not to an account. Restoring on a new device pulls the entitlement back from Apple, so no login is required.
support.still_stuck_email_us_with: Still stuck? Email us with the date of purchase and we will look into it.
support.how_do_i_cancel_or: How do I cancel or get a refund?
support.subscriptions_are_billed_by_appl: Subscriptions are billed by Apple, so cancellation and refunds go through Apple, not through us.
support.cancel_ios_settings_your_name: Cancel: iOS Settings → your name → Subscriptions → DrumFillGenerator → Cancel Subscription. Cancel at least 24 hours before the renewal date; you keep premium until the current period ends.
support.refund_request_it_at_reportaprob: Refund: request it at reportaproblem.apple.com. We cannot issue App Store refunds on Apple's behalf.
support.can_i_change_the_app: Can I change the app's language?
support.yes_settings_has_a_language: Yes. Settings has a language picker that changes the app immediately, independent of your system language. DrumFillGenerator ships in English, Ukrainian, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese (Portugal), Polish, Czech, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese.
support.yes_generation_the_full_curated: Yes. Generation, the full curated bank, playback, notation, and tracking all run entirely on-device with bundled audio samples. A connection is only used to refresh the curated catalog in the background and to load the subscription screen.
support.where_did_my_saved_fills: Where did my saved fills go?
support.favorites_are_stored_locally_on: Favorites are stored locally on the device and are not synced to iCloud in this version. Deleting the app removes them. Saved fills live in the Favorites tab — swipe a row to rename or delete it.
support.iphone_and_ipad_running_ios: iPhone and iPad running iOS 26.5 or later
support.none_no_sign_up_no: None. No sign-up, no login, no personal data required to use the app
support.optional_used_only_for_catalog: Optional — used only for catalog refresh and the subscription screen
support.requires_a_connected_usb_c: Requires a connected USB-C MIDI drum kit or pad; single-bar patterns only
support.not_available_in_this_version: Not available in this version (shown as "SOON")
support.multi_bar_fills_2_4: Multi-bar fills (2–4 bars), notation staff view, prefill/afterfill groove
support.the_app_has_no_accounts: The app has no accounts and collects no personal profile. Subscription state is handled by Apple and Adapty against an anonymous identifier, and pseudonymous diagnostics help us keep the audio engine stable. Audio is never recorded or stored.
support.to_request_access_to_or: To request access to or deletion of data associated with you, email us with as much detail as you can give (approximate purchase date, device) — there is no account to look up by name.
support.to_be_removed_from_the: To be removed from the launch waitlist, email us from the address you signed up with.
support.full_details_are_in_the: Full details are in the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.
support.requests_genuinely_shape_the_roa: Requests genuinely shape the roadmap — multi-bar tracking, microphone input, and iCloud sync for favorites are all on the list. Send yours to the support email above and say which drum kit and which style you practise; it helps us prioritise.
privacy.privacy_policy_for_drumfillgener: Privacy Policy for DrumFillGenerator — how we collect, use, and safeguard your information across our iOS app and website.
privacy.welcome_to_drumfillgenerator_we_: Welcome to DrumFillGenerator ("we," "our," or "us"). We are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our mobile application (the "App") and our website (the "Site").
privacy.please_read_this_privacy_policy: Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. By accessing or using the App or Site, you agree to the terms of this Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.
privacy.as_a_standalone_high_performance: As a standalone, high-performance practice tool, we follow a data minimization principle. We only collect information necessary to provide and monetize our services.
privacy.account_and_subscription_data_si: Account and Subscription Data: Since we utilize third-party SDKs for subscription handling (such as Adapty), anonymized transaction identifiers, purchase history, subscription status (Free Tier vs. Premium), and platform identifiers (Apple App Store ID) are processed to manage your access levels.
privacy.device_and_technical_data_we: Device and Technical Data: We may collect pseudonymous technical logs, including device model, iOS operating system version, app version, and basic performance telemetry. This data is critical for ensuring jitter-free audio performance and app stability.
privacy.waitlist_contact_data_if_you: Waitlist Contact Data: If you submit your email address through the Site's "Notify me" or "Join waitlist" forms, we store that email address together with the signup source, submission time, and page path used for the request.
privacy.website_analytics_data_optional_: Website Analytics Data (Optional): If you allow analytics on the Site, Google Analytics may process pseudonymous page-view and device/browser metadata so we can understand overall traffic patterns and improve the website.
privacy.audio_and_microphone_data_future: Audio and Microphone Data (Future Stages): The current version of the App operates strictly offline using preloaded audio samples. The App does not record, stream, or store ambient audio files.
privacy.we_use_the_collected_information: We use the collected information solely to:
privacy.validate_and_maintain_your_premi: Validate and maintain your Premium Active subscription state.
privacy.optimize_the_layout_responsivene: Optimize the layout responsiveness and performance of the audio engine (AVAudioEngine).
privacy.send_a_one_time_launch: Send a one-time launch notification or closely related release updates to people who explicitly joined the waitlist.
privacy.measure_aggregate_website_usage_: Measure aggregate website usage only when you have granted analytics consent on the Site.
privacy.comply_with_global_financial_tax: Comply with global financial, taxation, and legal regulations (including EU Digital Services Act and Apple App Store policies).
privacy.we_do_not_sell_rent: We do not sell, rent, or lease your personal data. To facilitate seamless in-app purchases, performance metrics, and waitlist management, we securely share minimal data with the following trusted providers:
privacy.apple_inc_app_store_connect: Apple Inc. (App Store Connect): For core payment processing, standard regional tax administration (VAT/Sales Tax), and secure user authentication.
privacy.adapty_adapty_tech_inc_for: Adapty (Adapty Tech Inc.): For server-side purchase validation, managing subscription access levels, and dynamic paywall configurations.
privacy.google_llc_google_analytics_for: Google LLC (Google Analytics): For privacy-aware website traffic measurement, and only after you opt in through our analytics consent prompt.
privacy.supabase_inc_for_securely_storin: Supabase, Inc.: For securely storing waitlist email submissions and related metadata used for launch notifications.
privacy.4_international_data_transfers_u: 4. International Data Transfers (US, EU, Ukraine, China)
privacy.your_technical_transactional_and: Your technical, transactional, and waitlist contact data may be stored and processed on secure cloud servers operated by our third-party infrastructure providers. We ensure that all transfers comply with prevailing framework regulations, including the GDPR (for EU users) and local privacy acts.
privacy.depending_on_your_geographic_loc: Depending on your geographic location, you may possess the right to:
privacy.request_access_to_the_data: Request access to the data we hold about you.
privacy.request_the_rectification_or_del: Request the rectification or deletion of your data.
privacy.accept_or_decline_website_analyt: Accept or decline website analytics through the consent prompt, then revisit that choice at any time through the "Cookie settings" button shown on the Site.
privacy.opt_out_of_waitlist_emails: Opt out of waitlist emails by contacting us and requesting removal of your submitted address.
privacy.manage_or_cancel_your_auto: Manage or cancel your auto-renewable subscriptions directly via your native Apple ID settings.
privacy.if_you_have_any_questions: If you have any questions or concerns regarding this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
